name: ffi_callback
summary: Wraps the LPC function pointer `fn` in a libffi closure with the given return and argument type codes (from <ffi.h>), and returns a callback handle. Pass ffi_callback_addr() of that handle to C as an FFI_POINTER argument so a C library (a comparator for qsort(), an event handler, ...) can call back into LPC.

availability.condition: 需要 PACKAGE_FFI 和 libffi；WebAssembly 目标不可用

signatures.label: int ffi_callback( function fn, int ret_type, int *arg_types )
